svg.title: AEGIS Finance
svg.desc: AEGIS Finance. Aegis is an open-source investment research system that writes down what it believes before an outcome exists, grades every belief against what then happens, and lets only graded beliefs change how paper capital is sized. RESULT IMPROVEMENT: NONE - the loop runs, grades itself, and freezes its alternatives. https://aegis-finance-six.vercel.app
svg.text: Aegis is an open-source investment research
